ai_review.summary: Enthusiastic audience capture of a rainy night with Jerry on the left and an energetic Phil performance.
ai_review.review: The lone review is wildly enthusiastic, recalling a rain‑soaked show where Jerry Garcia was positioned on the left side of the stage and Phil Lesh took the same spot later, prompting the reviewer to stay put. The writer also mentions Brent (likely Brent Mydland) grooving with the band, suggesting a lively atmosphere despite the lack of specific song references or recording details.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one five‑star review; strong positive language about the performance but no concrete information on audio quality, so rating leans toward show enjoyment with limited evidence.
